HUMMBL.expansion: Highly Useful Mental Model Base Language
HUMMBL.origin: Base120 (120 mental models across 6 transformation families: P, IN, CO, DE, RE, SY) is the 'Base Language' for reasoning. HUMMBL is the umbrella that makes those models 'Highly Useful' by wrapping them in governance, coordination, and operational infrastructure.
HUMMBL.misuse_notes: Prior to 2026-08-27, no acronym expansion was recorded in the project. 27 sites across docs mischaracterized HUMMBL by describing its function (governance, compliance, safety, evidence) instead of its name. HUMMBL is not 'an AI governance company' or 'a governance platform' — those are things it does, not what it is.
